events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde, still delivering those timeless Pretenders hits.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: A very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred. It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007's iconic adventures.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The brilliant British comedic actor and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
angles.copy: Still considered one of the greatest showmen in music history, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury today.

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed their sound and songwriting into new territory.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: It's the 46th anniversary of the tragic death of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose impact on music and culture remains immeasurable.
